items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: And he was awfully kind to me because a vibraphone player, Johnny Ray, was leaving.

ctx.x: You know, how to behave, how to carry yourself?
The Shearing thing. And you asked me did a guitar player help me? Toots was with him then — Toots Thielemans.
